notes: The infinitive absolute šāṭôaḥ takes the intensifier all while abroad stays with the verb as its particle; taking all abroad whole is the competing reading named in the unit note (rule 56).
The supplied object them of spread them has no object morpheme and is added.
In all that day the demonstrative hûʾ takes that and both articles go unrepresented, while in all the next day the rectum's article takes the fronted the (rules 28, 29, 41).
